record.user: A shop in Ajmer starts its week of Monday through Friday with a reported average of 36 parcels per day. On Tuesday it actually sent 42 and recorded 30. Friday includes 5 parcels counted twice. On Saturday the shop sends 51. What is the corrected daily average for all six days?
record.think:
The reported weekday total is 5 × 36 = 180 parcels.
Tuesday's missing count is 42 - 30 = 12.
The Tuesday correction raises the weekday figure to 180 + 12 = 192.
Removing the repeated Friday records leaves 192 - 5 = 187.
Saturday brings the corrected total to 187 + 51 = 238.
The corrected daily average is 238 / 6 = 119 / 3.
record.answer: The corrected average is 39 and 2/3 parcels per day.

record.user: On a Konkan route, Ravi plans three stretches of 45, 60 and 30 km. His actual second stretch is 12 km longer. He travels at a constant 42 km per hour over the first two stretches together and at 30 km per hour over the last. He stops for 20 minutes and has 4 hours for the trip. How much time does he have left at the end?
record.think:
The changed second stretch measures 60 + 12 = 72 km.
The initial two stretches cover 45 + 72 = 117 km.
Those stretches take 117 / 42 × 60 = 1170 / 7 minutes.
The final stretch lasts 30 / 30 × 60 = 60 minutes.
With the stop the trip takes 1170 / 7 + 60 + 20 = 1730 / 7 minutes.
The planned time is 4 × 60 = 240 minutes.
Time left is 240 - 1730 / 7 = -50 / 7 minutes, so he exceeds his allowance.
record.answer: Ravi finishes 7 and 1/7 minutes over the time allowance.

record.user: A co-operative in Nabarangpur wants to stitch 250 bags. Renu makes 20 bags an hour for the first two hours. Pooja joins at 22 bags an hour, and the pair works for three hours. They take a 15-minute break. Pooja alone finishes the order. How long from Renu's start does the order take?
record.think:
Renu's solo stint produces 2 × 20 = 40 bags.
The combined rate is 20 + 22 = 42 bags per hour.
The next three hours give 3 × 42 = 126 bags.
At the break, 250 - 40 - 126 = 84 bags remain.
Pooja takes 84 / 22 × 60 = 2520 / 11 minutes alone.
The first two stints and the break total 2 × 60 + 3 × 60 + 15 = 315 minutes.
The elapsed time is 315 + 2520 / 11 = 5985 / 11 minutes.
record.answer: The order takes exactly 544 and 1/11 minutes.

record.user: A tailor in Kasaragod makes 7 bags on the first day, twice as many the next and 3 more on the third day than on the second. What is her average number of bags per day?
record.think:
The second output is 2 × 7 = 14 bags.
The third output is 14 + 3 = 17 bags.
The full count is 7 + 14 + 17 = 38 bags.
Across three days the rate is 38 / 3 = 12 + 2 / 3.
record.answer: She averages 12 and 2/3 bags per day.

Bhilai mein 700 flyers chahiye. Machine A 18 per min par 10 min chali, fir B 22 per min ke saath 7 min chali. A band hui toh 3 min dono ruki. Phir B akeli baaki nikalegi. Start se kitne minute?
record.think:
A ke solo run ne 18 × 10 = 180 flyers diye.
Jab dono chali, speed 18 + 22 = 40 per min thi.
Saat min ka parallel output 7 × 40 = 280 hai.
Abhi 700 - 180 - 280 = 240 flyers bache hote, toh B ko unhe finish karna hai.
B mein 240 / 22 = 120 / 11 minute lagenge.
Break tak 10 + 7 + 3 = 20 minute guzre.
Kul 20 + 120 / 11 = 340 / 11 minute hain.
record.answer: Rate constant rahe toh kul 340/11 minute lagenge.

record.user: Nizamabad camp mein 183 bags tag karne hain. Hamid 18 per hour par 2 ghante solo kaam karta hai. Bina 21 per hour par join karti hai, dono teen ghante kaam karte hain aur 18 min rukte hain. Bina baaki akeli karegi. Shuruat se kitne minute?
record.think:
Hamid solo 2 × 18 = 36 bags karta hai.
Dono saath rate 18 + 21 = 39 bags per hour hai.
Joint stint mein 3 × 39 = 117 tags lage.
Bina ko end mein 183 - 36 - 117 = 30 bags milte hain.
Bina ka solo time 30 / 21 × 60 = 600 / 7 min hai.
Pehle teen parts ka time 2 × 60 + 3 × 60 + 18 = 318 min hai.
Total 318 + 600 / 7 = 2826 / 7 min hai.

record.user: Chitradurga bakery Mon-Fri daily average 42 bun antha book alli ide. Tuesday actual 46 badalu 34 enter maadidru. Thursday alli 6 bun eradu sala count aagide. Saturday 44 bun sale. Aaru dina correct average eshtu?
record.think:
Book total 5 × 42 = 210 buns.
Tuesday missing 46 - 34 = 12 buns.
Adanna serisidre 210 + 12 = 222.

Saturday add maadidaga 216 + 44 = 260 buns.
Daily average 260 / 6 = 130 / 3.

record.user: ರೋಣದ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ 900 ಲೀಟರ್ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಈಗ 210 ಲೀಟರ್ ಇದೆ. ಕೊಳವೆ ನಿಮಿಷಕ್ಕೆ 36 ಲೀಟರ್‌ನಂತೆ 15 ನಿಮಿಷ ತುಂಬಿಸ್ತು. ಆಗ ಮೋಟಾರು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ, ಅರ್ಧ ಗಂಟೆ ತೋಟಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಮಿಷಕ್ಕೆ 8 ಲೀಟರ್ ಬಿಟ್ಟರು. ತೋಟದ ಕೊಳವೆ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಅದೇ ಮೋಟಾರಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಿಸಿದರೆ ಪೂರ್ತಿ ತುಂಬೋಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಹೊತ್ತು?
record.think:
ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿ ಒಳಬಂದ ನೀರು 36 × 15 = 540 ಲೀಟರ್.
ಮೋಟಾರು ನಿಂತಾಗ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 210 + 540 = 750 ಲೀಟರ್ ಇತ್ತು.
ಅರ್ಧ ಗಂಟೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ 60 / 2 = 30 ನಿಮಿಷ.
ತೋಟದ ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಹೋದದ್ದು 30 × 8 = 240 ಲೀಟರ್.
ಆಮೇಲೆ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದದ್ದು 750 - 240 = 510 ಲೀಟರ್.
ಅಂಚಿಗೆ ತಲುಪೋಕೆ ಬೇಕಿರೋದು 900 - 510 = 390 ಲೀಟರ್.
ಕೊಳವೆಯ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ 390 / 36 = 65 / 6 ನಿಮಿಷ ಬೇಕು.
ಆ ಸಮಯ ಸೆಕೆಂಡಿಗೆ ತಂದರೆ 65 / 6 × 60 = 650 ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್, ಅಂದರೆ 10 ನಿಮಿಷ 50 ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್.

record.user: ಸೌದತ್ತಿಯ ಊಟದ ಮನೆಗೆ 118 ಪೊಟ್ಟಣ ಕಟ್ಟಬೇಕು. ಜಯಾ ಗಂಟೆಗೆ 18 ಪೊಟ್ಟಣ ಕಟ್ಟ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವಳು ಶುರು ಮಾಡಿ ಒಂದು ಗಂಟೆ ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಂಟೆಗೆ 22 ಕಟ್ಟೋ ಸವಿತಾ ಬಂದಳು. ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಎರಡು ಗಂಟೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ 15 ನಿಮಿಷ ವಿರಾಮ ತಗೊಂಡ್ರು. ಆಮೇಲೆ ಸವಿತಾ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮಿಕ್ಕಿದ್ದನ್ನು ಮುಗಿಸ್ತಾಳೆ. ಜಯಾ ಶುರು ಮಾಡಿದಾಗಿಂದ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಮಯ ಬೇಕು?
record.think:
ಜಯಾ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ಇದ್ದ ಮೊದಲ ಹೊತ್ತಲ್ಲಿ 1 × 18 = 18 ಪೊಟ್ಟಣ ಕಟ್ಟಿದಳು.
ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಜೊತೆಗಿದ್ದಾಗ ಗಂಟೆಗೆ 18 + 22 = 40 ಪೊಟ್ಟಣ ಆಯ್ತು.
ಎರಡು ಗಂಟೆಯ ಕೆಲಸ 2 × 40 = 80 ಪೊಟ್ಟಣ.
ವಿರಾಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುವಾಗ ಬಾಕಿ 118 - 18 - 80 = 20 ಪೊಟ್ಟಣ ಇತ್ತು.
ಸವಿತಾ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ 20 / 22 = 10 / 11 ಗಂಟೆ ತಗೊಳ್ತಾಳೆ.
ವಿರಾಮದ ಅವಧಿ 15 / 60 = 0.25 ಗಂಟೆ.
ಒಟ್ಟು ಹೊತ್ತು 1 + 2 + 0.25 + 10 / 11 = 183 / 44 ಗಂಟೆ.
record.answer: ಅದೇ ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ನಡೆದರೆ ಒಟ್ಟು 183/44 ಗಂಟೆ ಬೇಕು.
